clientName.title: Client display name
clientName.description: Product name the end-user Client App shows in its window title, header, Start-Menu shortcut, and notification sender — so each deployment can brand the client per customer (e.g. "端末管理支援ツール"). Set on the whole fleet (global scope); use the per-group / per-pc override below for exceptions.
clientName.label: Display name
clientName.hint: Save blank to fall back to the client's built-in default name (端末管理支援ツール).
clientName.loadErrorTitle: Failed to load client display name

toast.clearSuccess: Client display name reset to default
toast.notLoaded: Wait for the config to finish loading before saving

global.title: Global ConfigScope
global.description: Whole-fleet default. Per-group / per-pc overrides win over this.
global.overwriteWarning: This JSON editor overwrites the entire global scope. A display name saved via "Client display name" above is not reflected here until you reload the page — submitting a stale snapshot would silently drop it.

scope.title: Per-group / Per-PC override
scope.description: Partial ConfigScope — only fields you set survive. Empty fields fall through to the global scope.

confirm.deleteDescription: Removes the override; the scope falls back through the layered config.

effective.title: Effective config for one PC
effective.description: Same view the agent's config_supervisor computes locally. Built-in → global → groups (last-wins) → pc.
